spawn_multi_process: spawn multiple processes on a single node to run a test method across ranks
init_local_distributed_process_group: initialize a local single-rank distributed process group with the nccl backend
ForkedPdb_set_trace: debug a forked multiprocessing child process by attaching a pdb breakpoint on a specific rank
PGConfig_dataclass: create a PGConfig dataclass to configure backend, world size, and gradient partitioning group settings
init_pg_and_rank_and_launch_test: initialize a process group and rank environment then launch a test method in a spawned process
